messages:
Marta: Quick sync: planning base-image rebuild for next Tue 02:00-05:00 UTC. Reason: flagged OpenSSL CVE in current base. Two blockers: (1) signer service account needs new RBAC to access KMS-wrapped signing key, (2) audit logs must include image_author & signer.key_id. Need canary lane + rollback plan. Who's available for the window?
Sam: I can lead the canary lane + smoke tests. For RBAC, what's the minimum SA perms we expect?
Marta: Minimum: iam.serviceAccounts.get, access to KMS key via `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the key resource, and permission to push signed artifacts to GCR. We'll draft least-priv policy.
Ira: Please avoid giving secret access cluster-wide. Recommend namespace-scoped SA + key binding. Also consider keyless/cosign-with-OCI-signatures to reduce KMS surface. Any HSM path available?
Kevin: We should NOT rotate the old key during the rebuild. Proposal: create a new key version and use an envelope approach so we can fallback. Steps: create new key version, give signer SA access, keep old version active until canary green.
Chun: For audit logs, capture structured fields: `signer.key_id`, `signer.sa`, `image.digest`, `build_id`. Signer should emit a POST to our audit-ingest endpoint after successful sign. I'll open a PR to add the event.
Marta: PR will need sec review. @sec-oncall can you confirm the logging schema + retention? Also we need the incident runbook updated for failed canary -> auto-revoke signed image + redeploy previous.
sec-oncall: Ack. Logging schema: include signer.key_id, signer.service_account, digest, build_id. Retention: 1 year for infra logs. Alerting: canary-fail rate >5% over 10m triggers P1 and runbook.
Sam: Canary smoke plan: `docker run --rm image@sha256:<digest> /healthz`, lightweight HTTP verification and a small load test (vegeta). Rollback: revoke tag via registry API and trigger redeploy job to previous tag.
Marta: Who can prep the KMS side? @Kevin can you create key version and grant SA? Also need an oncall for the window — @Chun? Release freeze 1h prior.
Kevin: I'll prep key version, do not rotate old key. I'll grant signer SA `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` scoped to the key ring, and document the key-id. Leaving notes in infra key vault.
Chun: I'll cover the window and coordinate with releases for the freeze. I'll also monitor canary metrics and have rollback playbook ready.
deploy-bot: scheduled base-image-rebuild-canary -> Tue 02:00 UTC. Reminder 12h before.
Marta: Thanks all. Action items: Sam (canary tests + rollback scripts), Kevin (KMS key prep), Chun (oncall + releases sync), Ira (RBAC policy PR), me (runbook PR + calendar invite). :thumbsup:
